facts.fact: INSEED's regulatory-texts page names Loi N°026/PR/2019 on the organisation and regulation of statistical activities in Chad as the statistics law, which makes INSEED the central body of the national statistical system, and lists the law as dated June 2019.
facts.system: Loi N°026/PR/2019 portant organisation et règlementation des activités statistiques au Tchad

facts.fact: The same page lists three decrees dated July 2019 setting out the attributions, organisation and operation of the National Statistics Council, INSEED and the National Statistics Development Fund, alongside an undated decree on the CSS and CPS.
facts.system: Loi N°026/PR/2019 portant organisation et règlementation des activités statistiques au Tchad
